module
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Basic
public import Mathlib.Logic.Relation

/-!
An untrusted producer supplies a finite discovery trace. The checker verifies
that each new member has a declared edge from an already reached member and
that the resulting finite set is closed. It does not trust a claimed closure.
-/
@[expose] public section

namespace AC

abbrev Dependencies := Nat → Finset Nat

def Reachable (d : Dependencies) (seeds : Finset Nat) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ seed ∈ seeds, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => b ∈ d a) seed x

def Closed (d : Dependencies) (s : Finset Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ d x, y ∈ s

instance (d : Dependencies) (s : Finset Nat) : Decidable (Closed d s) := by
  unfold Closed
  infer_instance

def traceSet (known : Finset Nat) : List Nat → Finset Nat
  | [] => known
  | x :: rest => traceSet (insert x known) rest

def Witness (d : Dependencies) (known : Finset Nat) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: rest => (∃ parent ∈ known, x ∈ d parent) ∧ Witness d (insert x known) rest

instance witnessDecidable (d : Dependencies) (known : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) :
    Decidable (Witness d known trace) := by
  induction trace generalizing known with
  | nil => exact isTrue trivial
  | cons x rest ih =>
    dsimp [Witness]
    haveI := ih (insert x known)
    infer_instance

/-- All checks range over finite data. Reachability is established by `Witness`,
    not given to the verifier as a premise or an axiom. -/
def CertificateValid (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) : Prop :=
  seeds.Nonempty ∧ seeds ⊆ universeKeys ∧ traceSet seeds trace ⊆ universeKeys ∧
  Witness d seeds trace ∧ Closed d (traceSet seeds trace)

instance (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) :
    Decidable (CertificateValid d universeKeys seeds trace) := by
  unfold CertificateValid
  infer_instance

def checkCertificate (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (CertificateValid d universeKeys seeds trace)

theorem checkCertificate_valid (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (h : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true) :
    CertificateValid d universeKeys seeds trace := by
  simpa [checkCertificate] using h

theorem seed_reachable (d : Dependencies) (seeds : Finset Nat) {x : Nat}
    (h : x ∈ seeds) : Reachable d seeds x := ⟨x, h, .refl⟩

theorem reachable_step (d : Dependencies) (seeds : Finset Nat) {x y : Nat}
    (h : Reachable d seeds x) (edge : y ∈ d x) : Reachable d seeds y := by
  rcases h with ⟨seed, member, path⟩
  exact ⟨seed, member, path.tail edge⟩

theorem known_subset_traceSet (known : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) :
    known ⊆ traceSet known trace := by
  induction trace generalizing known with
  | nil => exact Finset.Subset.refl _
  | cons x rest ih =>
    exact Finset.Subset.trans (Finset.subset_insert x known) (ih (insert x known))

theorem witness_reachable (d : Dependencies) (seeds known : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat)
    (base : ∀ x ∈ known, Reachable d seeds x) (witness : Witness d known trace) :
    ∀ x ∈ traceSet known trace, Reachable d seeds x := by
  induction trace generalizing known with
  | nil => exact base
  | cons x rest ih =>
    rcases witness with ⟨⟨parent, hp, edge⟩, tail⟩
    apply ih (insert x known) _ tail
    intro y hy
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with equal | old
    · subst y
      exact reachable_step d seeds (base parent hp) edge
    · exact base y old

theorem reachable_in_closed (d : Dependencies) (seeds s : Finset Nat)
    (includeSeeds : seeds ⊆ s) (closed : Closed d s) {x : Nat}
    (h : Reachable d seeds x) : x ∈ s := by
  rcases h with ⟨seed, member, path⟩
  induction path with
  | refl => exact includeSeeds member
  | @tail b c path edge ih => exact closed b ih c edge

/-- Exact semantic connection to Mathlib's reflexive-transitive closure. -/
theorem certificate_exact_reachability (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (checked : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ traceSet seeds trace ↔ Reachable d seeds x := by
  have valid := checkCertificate_valid d universeKeys seeds trace checked
  constructor
  · exact witness_reachable d seeds seeds trace (fun _ h => seed_reachable d seeds h) valid.2.2.2.1 x
  · exact reachable_in_closed d seeds (traceSet seeds trace)
      (known_subset_traceSet seeds trace) valid.2.2.2.2

theorem certificate_seed_inclusion (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (_checked : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true) :
    seeds ⊆ traceSet seeds trace := known_subset_traceSet seeds trace

theorem certificate_closed (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (checked : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true) :
    Closed d (traceSet seeds trace) :=
  (checkCertificate_valid d universeKeys seeds trace checked).2.2.2.2

theorem certificate_least (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (checked : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true)
    (candidate : Finset Nat) (includeSeeds : seeds ⊆ candidate) (closed : Closed d candidate) :
    traceSet seeds trace ⊆ candidate := by
  intro x member
  exact reachable_in_closed d seeds candidate includeSeeds closed
    ((certificate_exact_reachability d universeKeys seeds trace checked x).mp member)

/-- The accepted finite result is a fixed point of Q ↦ seeds ∪ required(Q). -/
theorem certificate_fixed_point (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (checked : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds trace = true) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ traceSet seeds trace ↔
      x ∈ seeds ∨ ∃ parent ∈ traceSet seeds trace, x ∈ d parent := by
  constructor
  · intro member
    rcases (certificate_exact_reachability d universeKeys seeds trace checked x).mp member with
      ⟨seed, seedMember, path⟩
    rcases path.cases_tail with same | ⟨parent, initialPath, edge⟩
    · exact Or.inl (by simpa only [same] using seedMember)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨parent,
        (certificate_exact_reachability d universeKeys seeds trace checked parent).mpr
          ⟨seed, seedMember, initialPath⟩, edge⟩
  · intro member
    rcases member with seedMember | ⟨parent, parentMember, edge⟩
    · exact known_subset_traceSet seeds trace seedMember
    · exact certificate_closed d universeKeys seeds trace checked parent parentMember x edge

/-- Two successful certificates for exact same inputs cannot choose different sets. -/
theorem certificate_unique (d : Dependencies) (universeKeys seeds : Finset Nat)
    (left right : List Nat)
    (hl : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds left = true)
    (hr : checkCertificate d universeKeys seeds right = true) :
    traceSet seeds left = traceSet seeds right := by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro x
  rw [certificate_exact_reachability d universeKeys seeds left hl,
      certificate_exact_reachability d universeKeys seeds right hr]

end AC

/-! The reusable gate's complete generic proof root. Serialization is a separate
tested runtime boundary and is deliberately absent from this proof import graph. -/
public section

namespace AC

/-- Execute the original budget/projection computation on a domain whose model
and closure checks have already been proved. Proofs remain exact dependent inputs;
this is not an unchecked projection constructor or a cached status flag. -/
@[expose] def projectWithProof (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat)
    (budget : Nat) (_modelChecked : checkModel m = true)
    (_closureChecked : checkCertificate m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace = true) :
    Except String Projection :=
  if (traceSet seeds trace).card ≤ budget then
    .ok (makeProjection m seeds (traceSet seeds trace))
  else .error "insufficient record budget; required closure is not truncated"

theorem projectWithProof_eq_project (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat)
    (trace : List Nat) (budget : Nat)
    (modelChecked : checkModel m = true)
    (closureChecked : checkCertificate m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace = true) :
    projectWithProof m seeds trace budget modelChecked closureChecked =
      project m seeds trace budget := by
  simp [projectWithProof, project, modelChecked, closureChecked]

end AC

module
public import AC.Projection
public import AC.Structure
public import AC.GateProof
public import Lean.Data.Json.Basic
@[expose] public section
namespace AC.GateRuntime
open Lean

def familyName : Family → String
  | .objects => "objects"
  | .relations => "relations"
  | .constraints => "constraints"
  | .latitude => "latitude"
  | .residuals => "residuals"
  | .traversals => "traversals"
  | .transformations => "transformations"
  | .judgments => "judgments"

def recordJson (r : Record) : Json := Json.mkObj [
  ("key", toJson r.key), ("identity", toJson r.identity), ("family", toJson (familyName r.family)),
  ("context", toJson r.context), ("owner", toJson r.owner), ("scope", toJson r.scope),
  ("basis", toJson r.basis), ("payload", toJson r.payload)]

def pathStepJson : PathStep → Json
  | .field name => Json.mkObj [("field", toJson name)]
  | .index position => Json.mkObj [("index", toJson position)]

def referenceJson (r : Reference) : Json := Json.mkObj [
  ("owner", toJson r.owner), ("path", Json.arr (r.path.map pathStepJson).toArray),
  ("target", match r.target with
    | .localRecord key => Json.mkObj [("local", toJson key)]
    | .external identity => Json.mkObj [("external", toJson identity)]),
  ("governing", toJson r.governing), ("domain", toJson r.domain)]

def externalJson (e : External) : Json := Json.mkObj [
  ("identity", toJson e.identity), ("payload", toJson e.payload)]

/-- Output ordering follows the source record indices; canonical payload bytes
    are emitted directly rather than being reparsed and normalized in Lean. -/
def keysJson (m : Model) (keys : Finset Nat) : Json :=
  toJson ((m.records.map Record.key).filter fun key => decide (key ∈ keys))

def projectionJson (m : Model) (p : Projection) : Json := Json.mkObj [
  ("parentIdentity", toJson p.parentIdentity), ("parentRawSha256", toJson p.parentRawSha256),
  ("parentCanonicalSha256", toJson p.parentCanonicalSha256), ("parentEnvelope", toJson p.parentEnvelope),
  ("seeds", keysJson m p.seeds), ("included", keysJson m p.included), ("excluded", keysJson m p.excluded),
  ("records", Json.arr (p.records.map recordJson).toArray),
  ("external", Json.arr (p.external.map externalJson).toArray),
  ("ordinary", Json.arr (p.ordinary.map referenceJson).toArray),
  ("unresolved", Json.arr (p.unresolved.map recordJson).toArray),
  ("excludedResiduals", Json.arr (p.excludedResiduals.map recordJson).toArray),
  ("invalidation", toJson p.invalidation)]


def modelJson (m : Model) : Json := Json.mkObj [
  ("identity", toJson m.identity), ("rawSha256", toJson m.rawSha256),
  ("canonicalSha256", toJson m.canonicalSha256), ("envelope", toJson m.envelope),
  ("records", Json.arr (m.records.map recordJson).toArray),
  ("references", Json.arr (m.references.map referenceJson).toArray),
  ("externalResolutions", Json.arr (m.externalResolutions.map externalJson).toArray),
  ("edges", toJson (m.edges.map fun e => [e.1, e.2])), ("invalidation", toJson m.invalidation)]

def selectionResultJson (m : Model) (result : Except String Projection) : Json :=
  match result with
  | .ok p => Json.mkObj [("status", toJson "verified"), ("projection", projectionJson m p)]
  | .error reason => Json.mkObj [("status", toJson "refused"), ("reason", toJson reason)]

/-- Original unchecked entry point; its runtime checker cost is unchanged. -/
def gateSelectionJson (m : Model) (s : Finset Nat × List Nat × Nat) : Json :=
  let (seeds, trace, budget) := s
  selectionResultJson m (project m seeds trace budget)

end AC.GateRuntime

module
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card

/-!
A source-bound finite representation. `payload` and `envelope` contain complete
canonical JSON, not interpretations of prose predicates. Importing JSON and
extracting the declared dependency relation is an explicit boundary outside Lean.
-/
@[expose] public section

namespace AC

inductive Family where
  | objects | relations | constraints | latitude | residuals
  | traversals | transformations | judgments
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Record where
  key : Nat
  identity : String
  family : Family
  context : String
  owner : String
  scope : String
  basis : String
  payload : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Target where
  | localRecord (key : Nat)
  | external (identity : String)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive PathStep where
  | field (name : String)
  | index (position : Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Reference where
  owner : Nat
  path : List PathStep
  target : Target
  governing : Bool
  domain : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure External where
  identity : String
  payload : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Model where
  identity : String
  rawSha256 : String
  canonicalSha256 : String
  envelope : String
  records : List Record
  references : List Reference
  externalResolutions : List External
  edges : List (Nat × Nat)
  invalidation : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Model.localKeys (m : Model) : Finset Nat := (m.records.map Record.key).toFinset

def Model.dependencies (m : Model) (key : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  (m.edges.filterMap fun e => if e.1 == key then some e.2 else none).toFinset

def Target.Resolves (keys : Finset Nat) (external : List String) : Target → Prop
  | .localRecord key => key ∈ keys
  | .external name => name ∈ external

instance (keys : Finset Nat) (external : List String) (target : Target) :
    Decidable (target.Resolves keys external) := by
  cases target <;> dsimp [Target.Resolves] <;> infer_instance

/-- This checks only the imported finite structural fragment, not schema meaning. -/
def Model.WellFormed (m : Model) : Prop :=
  (m.records.map Record.key).Nodup ∧
  (m.records.map Record.identity).Nodup ∧
  (m.externalResolutions.map External.identity).Nodup ∧
  (∀ r ∈ m.records, r.identity ∉ m.externalResolutions.map External.identity) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ m.edges, e.1 ∈ m.localKeys ∧ e.2 ∈ m.localKeys) ∧
  (∀ ref ∈ m.references, ref.owner ∈ m.localKeys ∧
    ref.target.Resolves m.localKeys (m.externalResolutions.map External.identity))

instance (m : Model) : Decidable m.WellFormed := by
  unfold Model.WellFormed
  infer_instance

def checkModel (m : Model) : Bool := decide m.WellFormed

theorem checkModel_sound (m : Model) (h : checkModel m = true) : m.WellFormed := by
  simpa [checkModel] using h

end AC

module
public import AC.Model
public import AC.Closure

@[expose] public section

namespace AC

def retained (m : Model) (selected : Finset Nat) : List Record :=
  m.records.filter fun r => decide (r.key ∈ selected)

/-- No record fields are rewritten. This also conserves opaque predicates,
    ordered arrays, repeated values, owner, basis, scope, and residual payloads. -/
theorem retained_iff (m : Model) (selected : Finset Nat) (r : Record) :
    r ∈ retained m selected ↔ r ∈ m.records ∧ r.key ∈ selected := by
  simp [retained]

def externalBoundary (m : Model) (selected : Finset Nat) : List External :=
  m.externalResolutions.filter fun e =>
    m.references.any fun ref => ref.owner ∈ selected && ref.target == .external e.identity

def ordinaryBoundary (m : Model) (selected : Finset Nat) : List Reference :=
  m.references.filter fun ref => ref.owner ∈ selected &&
    match ref.target with
    | .localRecord key => !(key ∈ selected)
    | .external _ => false

def residualBoundary (m : Model) (selected : Finset Nat) : List Record :=
  (retained m selected).filter fun r => r.family == .residuals

def excludedResidualBoundary (m : Model) (selected : Finset Nat) : List Record :=
  m.records.filter fun r => !(r.key ∈ selected) && r.family == .residuals

structure Projection where
  parentIdentity : String
  parentRawSha256 : String
  parentCanonicalSha256 : String
  parentEnvelope : String
  seeds : Finset Nat
  included : Finset Nat
  excluded : Finset Nat
  records : List Record
  external : List External
  ordinary : List Reference
  unresolved : List Record
  excludedResiduals : List Record
  invalidation : String

def makeProjection (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) : Projection where
  parentIdentity := m.identity
  parentRawSha256 := m.rawSha256
  parentCanonicalSha256 := m.canonicalSha256
  parentEnvelope := m.envelope
  seeds := seeds
  included := selected
  excluded := m.localKeys \ selected
  records := retained m selected
  external := externalBoundary m selected
  ordinary := ordinaryBoundary m selected
  unresolved := residualBoundary m selected
  excludedResiduals := excludedResidualBoundary m selected
  invalidation := m.invalidation

/-- Finite record budget. No initialPath/truncation branch can return success. -/
def project (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) (budget : Nat) :
    Except String Projection :=
  if checkModel m && checkCertificate m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace then
    if (traceSet seeds trace).card ≤ budget then
      .ok (makeProjection m seeds (traceSet seeds trace))
    else .error "insufficient record budget; required closure is not truncated"
  else .error "invalid imported model or closure certificate"

theorem projection_success (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) (budget : Nat)
    (modelChecked : checkModel m = true)
    (closureChecked : checkCertificate m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace = true)
    (fits : (traceSet seeds trace).card ≤ budget) :
    project m seeds trace budget = .ok (makeProjection m seeds (traceSet seeds trace)) := by
  simp [project, modelChecked, closureChecked, fits]

/-- Eliminate a real executable success result; callers cannot substitute an
    arbitrary projection while appealing only to the generic theorem. -/
theorem project_ok_properties (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat)
    (budget : Nat) (p : Projection) (result : project m seeds trace budget = .ok p) :
    checkModel m = true ∧
    checkCertificate m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace = true ∧
    (traceSet seeds trace).card ≤ budget ∧
    p = makeProjection m seeds (traceSet seeds trace) := by
  unfold project at result
  split at result
  · rename_i checks
    have checked : checkModel m = true ∧
        checkCertificate m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace = true := by
      simpa using checks
    split at result
    · rename_i fits
      exact ⟨checked.1, checked.2, fits, (Except.ok.inj result).symm⟩
    · cases result
  · cases result

theorem project_ok_exact_reachability (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat)
    (budget : Nat) (p : Projection) (result : project m seeds trace budget = .ok p)
    (x : Nat) : x ∈ p.included ↔ Reachable m.dependencies seeds x := by
  have facts := project_ok_properties m seeds trace budget p result
  rw [facts.2.2.2]
  exact certificate_exact_reachability m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace facts.2.1 x

theorem insufficient_budget_refuses (m : Model) (seeds : Finset Nat) (trace : List Nat) (budget : Nat)
    (modelChecked : checkModel m = true)
    (closureChecked : checkCertificate m.dependencies m.localKeys seeds trace = true)
    (insufficient : budget < (traceSet seeds trace).card) :
    project m seeds trace budget =
      .error "insufficient record budget; required closure is not truncated" := by
  simp [project, modelChecked, closureChecked, Nat.not_le.mpr insufficient]

theorem projection_record_conservation (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) (r : Record) :
    r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).records ↔ r ∈ m.records ∧ r.key ∈ selected :=
  retained_iff m selected r

theorem projection_authority_basis_conservation (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat)
    (r : Record) (h : r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).records) :
    ∃ original ∈ m.records, original = r ∧ original.owner = r.owner ∧
      original.scope = r.scope ∧ original.context = r.context ∧ original.basis = r.basis ∧
      original.payload = r.payload := by
  exact ⟨r, (projection_record_conservation m seeds selected r).mp h |>.1,
    rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem projection_residual_conservation (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) (r : Record) :
    r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).unresolved ↔
      r ∈ m.records ∧ r.key ∈ selected ∧ r.family = .residuals := by
  simp [makeProjection, residualBoundary, retained, and_assoc, and_comm]

theorem projection_excluded_exact (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).excluded ↔ x ∈ m.localKeys ∧ x ∉ selected := by
  simp [makeProjection]

theorem projection_external_exact (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) (e : External) :
    e ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).external ↔
      e ∈ m.externalResolutions ∧ ∃ ref ∈ m.references,
        ref.owner ∈ selected ∧ ref.target = .external e.identity := by
  simp [makeProjection, externalBoundary]

theorem projection_ordinary_exact (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) (ref : Reference) :
    ref ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).ordinary ↔
      ref ∈ m.references ∧ ref.owner ∈ selected ∧
        ∃ key, ref.target = .localRecord key ∧ key ∉ selected := by
  cases h : ref.target <;> simp [makeProjection, ordinaryBoundary, h]

theorem projection_excluded_residual_exact (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat)
    (r : Record) :
    r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).excludedResiduals ↔
      r ∈ m.records ∧ r.key ∉ selected ∧ r.family = .residuals := by
  simp [makeProjection, excludedResidualBoundary]

/-- Every original residual is either retained unresolved or explicitly named as
    an excluded residual; exclusion is never interpreted as disposition. -/
theorem projection_all_residuals_accounted (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat)
    (r : Record) (original : r ∈ m.records) (residual : r.family = .residuals) :
    r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).unresolved ∨
      r ∈ (makeProjection m seeds selected).excludedResiduals := by
  by_cases h : r.key ∈ selected
  · exact Or.inl ((projection_residual_conservation m seeds selected r).mpr
      ⟨original, h, residual⟩)
  · exact Or.inr ((projection_excluded_residual_exact m seeds selected r).mpr
      ⟨original, h, residual⟩)

theorem projection_parent_conservation (m : Model) (seeds selected : Finset Nat) :
    (makeProjection m seeds selected).parentIdentity = m.identity ∧
    (makeProjection m seeds selected).parentRawSha256 = m.rawSha256 ∧
    (makeProjection m seeds selected).parentCanonicalSha256 = m.canonicalSha256 ∧
    (makeProjection m seeds selected).parentEnvelope = m.envelope ∧
    (makeProjection m seeds selected).invalidation = m.invalidation := by
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

end AC

module
public import AC.Model

/-! Efficient certificates for the unchanged structural property. Payloads remain
in the actual Model; these lemmas avoid repeatedly deciding irrelevant fields. -/
@[expose] public section
namespace AC

/-- Exact list reconstruction without normalizing every concrete indexed lookup.
The array still contains the complete original identities. -/
theorem array_reconstruct {α : Type} (xs : Array α) (fallback : α) :
    xs.toList = (List.range xs.size).map (fun i => xs[i]?.getD fallback) := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i hi hj
    simp only [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, Array.getElem_toList]
    simp [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simpa using hi)]

def mergeIndices : Nat → List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | 0, xs, ys => xs ++ ys
  | _ + 1, [], ys => ys
  | _ + 1, xs, [] => xs
  | fuel + 1, x :: xs, y :: ys =>
    if x ≤ y then x :: mergeIndices fuel xs (y :: ys)
    else y :: mergeIndices fuel (x :: xs) ys

theorem mergeIndices_perm (fuel : Nat) (xs ys : List Nat) :
    (mergeIndices fuel xs ys).Perm (xs ++ ys) := by
  induction fuel generalizing xs ys with
  | zero => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | succ fuel ih =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => simp only [mergeIndices, List.nil_append]; exact List.Perm.refl _

  | fuel + 1, xs =>
    let left := xs.take (xs.length / 2)
    let right := xs.drop (xs.length / 2)
    mergeIndices xs.length (sortIndices fuel left) (sortIndices fuel right)

theorem sortIndices_perm (fuel : Nat) (names : List Nat) :
    (sortIndices fuel names).Perm names := by
  induction fuel generalizing names with
  | zero => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | succ fuel ih =>
    unfold sortIndices
    exact (mergeIndices_perm _ _ _).trans
      (((ih _).append (ih _)).trans (by rw [List.take_append_drop]))

  | 0, xs, ys => xs ++ ys
  | _ + 1, [], ys => ys
  | _ + 1, xs, [] => xs
  | fuel + 1, x :: xs, y :: ys =>
    if x.1 ≤ y.1 then x :: mergeLabeled fuel xs (y :: ys)
    else y :: mergeLabeled fuel (x :: xs) ys

    (mergeLabeled fuel xs ys).Perm (xs ++ ys) := by
  induction fuel generalizing xs ys with
  | zero => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | succ fuel ih =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => simp only [mergeLabeled, List.nil_append]; exact List.Perm.refl _
    | cons x xs =>
      cases ys with
      | nil => simp only [mergeLabeled, List.append_nil]; exact List.Perm.refl _
      | cons y ys =>
        simp only [mergeLabeled]
        split
        · exact (ih xs (y :: ys)).cons x
        · exact ((ih (x :: xs) ys).cons y).trans List.perm_middle.symm

  | 0, xs => xs
  | fuel + 1, xs =>
    let left := xs.take (xs.length / 2)
    let right := xs.drop (xs.length / 2)
    mergeLabeled xs.length (sortLabeled fuel left) (sortLabeled fuel right)

    (sortLabeled fuel values).Perm values := by
  induction fuel generalizing values with
  | zero => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | succ fuel ih =>
    unfold sortLabeled
    exact (mergeLabeled_perm _ _ _).trans
      (((ih _).append (ih _)).trans (by rw [List.take_append_drop]))

    (labeled : List (Nat × List Char)) (fuel : Nat)
    (source : (sortLabeled fuel labeled).map (fun p => String.ofList p.2) = names)
    (ordered : (labeled.map Prod.snd).IsChain (· < ·)) : names.Nodup := by
  have nd : (labeled.map Prod.snd).Nodup :=
    ordered.pairwise.imp (fun {a b} h eq => by subst b; exact List.lt_irrefl a h)
  have rendered : (labeled.map (fun p => String.ofList p.2)).Nodup := by
    simpa only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using
      nd.map (fun _ _ h => String.ofList_injective h)
  rw [← source]
  exact ((sortLabeled_perm fuel labeled).map (fun p => String.ofList p.2)).nodup_iff.mpr rendered

    (localChars externalChars : List (List Char))
    (labeled : List (Nat × List Char)) (fuel : Nat)
    (source : (sortLabeled fuel labeled).map Prod.snd = localChars ++ externalChars)
    (localSource : localChars.map String.ofList = localNames)
    (externalSource : externalChars.map String.ofList = externalNames) :
    (sortLabeled fuel labeled).map (fun p => String.ofList p.2) = localNames ++ externalNames := by
  change (sortLabeled fuel labeled).map (String.ofList ∘ Prod.snd) = _
  rw [← List.map_map, source, List.map_append, localSource, externalSource]

is required. Exact zip equality ties the checked pairs to the complete order. -/
theorem isChain_of_pairs {α : Type} (relation : α → α → Prop) (values : List α)

    values.IsChain relation := by
  induction values with
  | nil => exact List.IsChain.nil
  | cons a values ih =>
    cases values with
    | nil => exact List.IsChain.singleton a
    | cons b rest =>
      apply List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr
      constructor
      · exact checked (a,b) (List.mem_cons_self)
      · apply ih
        intro pair member
        exact checked pair (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)

    ∀ r ∈ records, r.identity ∉ external := by
  intro r hr he
  exact (List.nodup_append.mp unique).2.2 _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩) _ he rfl

the producer's table is trusted without the equality and block inclusion. -/

    (index : Nat) (value : α)
    (inside : ∀ x ∈ block.toList, x ∈ all)
    (atIndex : block[index]? = some value) : value ∈ all := by
  apply inside
  exact Array.mem_toList_iff.mpr (Array.mem_of_getElem? atIndex)

    (blocks : List (List α)) (block : List α) (member : block ∈ blocks) :
    ∀ x ∈ block.map project, x ∈ blocks.flatten.map project := by
  intro x hx
  rw [List.map_flatten]
  exact List.mem_flatten.mpr
    ⟨block.map project, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨block, member, rfl⟩, hx⟩

    (order : List Nat) (n fuel : Nat)
    (source : names = (List.range n).map lookup)
    (permutation : sortIndices fuel order = List.range n)
    (sorted : (order.map lookup).IsChain (· < ·)) : names.Nodup := by
  have perm : order.Perm (List.range n) := by
    rw [← permutation]
    exact (sortIndices_perm fuel order).symm
  have nd : (order.map lookup).Nodup :=
    sorted.pairwise.imp (fun {a b} h eq => by
      subst b
      exact String.lt_irrefl a h)
  rw [source]
  exact (perm.map lookup).nodup_iff.mp nd

  | .localRecord key => key < n
  | .external name => name ∈ external

instance (n : Nat) (external : List String) (target : Target) :
    Decidable (targetBound n external target) := by
  cases target <;> dsimp [targetBound] <;> infer_instance

theorem all_flatten {α : Type} (p : α → Prop) (chunks : List (List α))
    (h : ∀ block ∈ chunks, ∀ a ∈ block, p a) :
    ∀ a ∈ chunks.flatten, p a := by
  intro a member
  obtain ⟨block, hb, ha⟩ := List.mem_flatten.mp member
  exact h block hb a ha

theorem localKeys_range (m : Model) (n : Nat)
    (keys : m.records.map Record.key = List.range n) : m.localKeys = Finset.range n := by
  ext x
  simp only [Model.localKeys, keys, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_range, Finset.mem_range]

theorem wellFormed_of_range (m : Model) (n : Nat)
    (keys : m.records.map Record.key = List.range n)
    (names : (m.records.map Record.identity).Nodup)
    (external : (m.externalResolutions.map External.identity).Nodup)
    (separate : ∀ r ∈ m.records, r.identity ∉ m.externalResolutions.map External.identity)
    (edges : ∀ e ∈ m.edges, e.1 < n ∧ e.2 < n)
    (refs : ∀ r ∈ m.references, r.owner < n ∧
      targetBound n (m.externalResolutions.map External.identity) r.target) :
    m.WellFormed := by
  refine ⟨?_, names, external, separate, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [keys]
    exact List.nodup_range
  · intro e he
    simpa only [localKeys_range m n keys, Finset.mem_range] using edges e he
  · intro r hr
    have bounds := refs r hr
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [localKeys_range m n keys, Finset.mem_range] using bounds.1
    · cases h : r.target <;>
        simpa only [h, targetBound, Target.Resolves, localKeys_range m n keys,
          Finset.mem_range] using bounds.2

  simpa only [checkModel, decide_eq_true_eq] using h
